title: Portuguese Frittata
description: A Portuguese-inspired frittata made with eggs, jazzed up with jazzy peppers and jammy tomatoes.
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl and season with salt.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add jazzed-up peppers.
Add jammy tomatoes and cook until softened.
Pour whisked eggs over the vegetables and cook until edges start to set.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Remove from oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
